questions.stem:
The discrete random variable $R$ has the distribution $R \sim \mathrm{B}(n,p)$

The mean of $R$ is 200

parts.label: a
parts.text:
(a) State the variance of $R$ in terms of $p$
(1)
parts.mark_scheme: (a) $200(1-p)$ oe as variance. Must be seen in (a). isw if they subsequently square root to find sd or multiply out and make errors B1

parts.label: b
parts.text:
A normal distribution is used as an approximation for $R$

Using this approximation, $\mathrm{P}(R<180)=0.0307$ to 3 significant figures.

(b) Show that $\sqrt{200-200p}=10.96$ to 4 significant figures.
(5)
parts.mark_scheme: (b) $(z=)\pm\frac{179.5-200}{"\sqrt{200(1-p)}"}$ M1: attempt at continuity correction, sight of 179.5 or 180.5 may be implied by 19.5 or 20.5 imp. by a correct equation. M1: standardisation using their Normal distribution $\mathrm{N}(200,(a))$ (Note use of 220.5 for 179.5 and $z=1.87$ implied by a correct equation. Condone use of 180 for this mark. Allow use of $200(1-p)$ in (b) if (a) is incorrect. A1ft: for correct standardisation, ft their variance. Must have scored M1M1. $z=(\pm)1.87$ B1: awrt $\pm 1.87$ calculator gives $-1.8706$ $\frac{179.5-200}{\sqrt{200(1-p)}}=-1.87$ $*\sqrt{200(1-p)}=\frac{-20.5}{-1.87}=10.962\ldots*$ A1*cso: cso for achieving awrt 10.963 following a correct equation i.e. when their standardised expression is equated to $\pm 1.87$ the signs must be compatible otherwise A0*. If using a calculator to find the z-value look for awrt 10.959. $\frac{179.5-200}{\sqrt{200(1-p)}}=-1.87$ oe scores M1M1A1ftB1

parts.label: c
parts.text:
(c) Hence find the value of $p$, giving your answer to 2 significant figures.
(2)
parts.mark_scheme: (c) $1-p=0.600889\ldots$ or $200-200p=\frac{75076}{625}(=120.1216) \Rightarrow 200p=\frac{49924}{625}(=79.8784)$ M1: for rearranging the given answer to part (b) to $1-p=$ awrt 0.6 oe or $200p=$ awrt 80 oe using the correct order of operations. Implied by awrt 0.4. May also rearrange to $p=\frac{10.96^2-200}{-200}$ or equivalent which implies this mark. $p=0.39911\ldots$ awrt $p=0.40$ A1: awrt 0.40, use of 10.96 gives 0.399392
